Subject: Request to Reschedule Thursday’s Call

Hi [Client Name],

I hope you’re well. I need to cancel our scheduled call on Thursday—my apologies for the short notice and any inconvenience this causes. Would you be available to reschedule? I’m free on [Option A: day/time] or [Option B: day/time], but I’m happy to work around your schedule—please let me know what suits you.

If anything is urgent before we reconnect, please email me or call me at [phone number]. Thanks for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

Would you like a shorter or more formal version, or should I tailor the suggested times?
